recorded_deviations.how_it_is_verified: every template is parsed back and its declared width, height and resolution checked against 300x400 @ 197 ppcm before it is written; a template describing any other geometry is recorded as a failure and never stored

recorded_deviations.deviation: the SDK directory is made the working directory before the first call
recorded_deviations.why: sgfplib loads its companions with a plain LoadLibrary by name, which searches the working directory. Upstream's own instruction is 'copy the DLLs into the current directory'; this reaches the same arrangement without copying vendor binaries around

recorded_deviations.deviation: one process extracts many images instead of one process per image
recorded_deviations.why: upstream's extract.bat spawns an interpreter per image; the SDK handle is still created, initialised and terminated once per image, so nothing is carried between them
